title: Deduplicate API_KEY / CORDUM_API_KEY env vars
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**Files**: `docker-compose.yml:90-91`, `cmd/cordumctl/init.go:82-83`

**Issue**: Both `API_KEY` and `CORDUM_API_KEY` are set to the same value redundantly. Code should use a single canonical variable. Having two names for the same thing causes confusion and potential drift.

**Fix**: Audit which variable the gateway actually reads (grep for both in gateway code), remove the legacy one, update docker-compose.yml and the init template in init.go.
definitionOfDone: Determined which env var is canonical (likely CORDUM_API_KEY)
Removed the legacy duplicate from docker-compose.yml and init.go
Gateway code reads only the canonical variable

implementationPlan.description: The gateway's `loadBasicAPIKeys()` in basic_auth.go:335-361 reads env vars in priority order: CORDUM_API_KEYS → CORDUM_API_KEY → API_KEY. The `API_KEY` fallback exists for backwards compatibility. **Decision**: Keep the fallback chain in gateway code (it's harmless and aids migration), but remove the redundant `API_KEY` line from docker-compose.yml and init.go since `CORDUM_API_KEY` is already set and the fallback makes the duplicate unnecessary.

In docker-compose.yml, remove line 90 (`API_KEY=${CORDUM_API_KEY:?...}`) from the api-gateway service. The gateway will read `CORDUM_API_KEY` directly (line 91). Similarly, in init.go remove the `API_KEY` line (line 82) from the generated compose template, keeping only `CORDUM_API_KEY` (line 83).

Add a deprecation log in basic_auth.go: when `API_KEY` is used (line 356 path), log `slog.Warn("API_KEY env var is deprecated, use CORDUM_API_KEY instead")` so operators using the legacy variable get notified.
Update auth_test.go test cases that test `API_KEY` fallback (line 353) to verify the deprecation warning is logged.
Run `go test ./core/controlplane/gateway/... ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
